topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: Walking through the bustling city, my eyes caught a glimpse of something familiar—a vibrant swirl of colors and patterns mirroring my latest gallery exhibit. My heart skipped, and I approached, almost in a trance. There, on a young woman’s arm, was my art, a living canvas breathing life into my creation. I watched her move, the lines and hues dancing with her. People brushed past, oblivious, but I stood there, seeing my vision pulsate in a new form. It was a strange, powerful moment, my art no longer confined to the walls, but part of someone, flowing through their veins. I felt a surge, a deep connection to the world in a way I hadn’t before. This was more than art; it was a bridge, a bond, a story woven into the fabric of another’s life.
